svg.aria-label: Breadboard drawing of the Velostat LED circuit. A power module at the left end of the breadboard powers the + and – rails with 5V. A black wire goes from the – rail to the LED's short leg. The LED's long leg shares a row with one leg of a 220 ohm resistor; the resistor's other leg is in its own row. A blue wire from that row and a red wire from the + rail clip onto the two copper tails of the Velostat sensor.
svg.text: + rail (5V) → red wire → Velostat → blue wire → 220Ω resistor → LED long leg → LED short leg → black wire → – rail
Long-leg row: the LED's long leg + one leg of the 220Ω resistor
Short-leg row: the LED's short leg + the black wire to the – rail
Free row: the resistor's other leg + the blue wire to the sensor
